fullSource:
use default

let plates = STACK[string]()

plates.push("bottom")
plates.push("middle")
plates.push("top")

write_line("depth: {plates.count}")
write_line("peek:  {plates.peek()}")

while plates.count > 0 do
    write_line("pop:   {plates.pop()}")
od

write_line("empty: {plates.count == 0}")
output:
depth: 3
peek:  top
pop:   top
pop:   middle
pop:   bottom
empty: True
